verdict.rationale: The evidence confirms portfolios are a first-party Asana object: the official MCP server searches portfolios, and users can 'check on portfolios' from ChatGPT. No item describes how a portfolio view rolls up progress across multiple projects. Support rests on thin MCP-related mentions rather than portfolio feature docs. Missing for 10: documentation of a portfolio view aggregating multi-project progress or status, rollup metrics or fields, any UI description of the portfolio view, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can roll up progress across multiple projects into a single portfolio view

citations.quote: From a single ChatGPT conversation, you can check on portfolios, create and assign tasks, kick off new projects, and review work—all without switching between tools.
Searches tasks, projects, project templates, portfolios, goals, teams, users, tags, custom fields, and AI Teammates by name.
